**1 issue found** across 2 files Confidence score: **4/5** - In `src/commands/scrape.ts`, a local `fs.writeFileSync` failure is reported as a download/network failure, which can send debugging in the wrong direction. Narrow the catch to fetch/read operations or distinguish save errors in the warning.
Prompt for AI agents (unresolved issues) ```text Check if these issues are valid — if so, understand the root cause of each and fix them. When an issue isn't valid or won't be fixed in this PR, reply in its thread with the reason and then resolve the thread. If appropriate, use sub-agents to investigate and fix each issue separately. P3: This catch also handles `fs.writeFileSync`, so local save failures are reported as download/network failures. Narrow the catch to the fetch/read operations or distinguish save errors in the warning. ```
**Shadow auto-approve**: would auto-approve with 1 open P3 issue. Adds stderr warnings in scrape --all when a requested screenshot cannot be downloaded, reporting the page URL and reason, while keeping the existing skip behavior and exit code unchanged. The change is narrowly scoped and covered by new tests for both non-OK responses and thrown errors.
